rationale: The assistant led with filter and spray arm cleaning, which matches the hidden cause, and correctly recommended no parts. It handled the blocked holes and stiff arm sensibly and covered salt, rinse aid and scraping plates. Weaknesses: it never asked which programme was used (the customer ran a quick 30-minute wash), and it asserted 'your water is hard and the softener isn't keeping up' when the customer never said the salt was topped up. The first reply was also long and a bit scattershot, with some repeated advice such as the hot cleaning cycle.
